annotations.title: Get county court and filing info

description: Get verified court information for one U.S. county: clerk contacts, courthouse address, e-filing provider and whether it is mandatory, filing fees, case lookup, self-help, jury service and payment links, with the date it was last verified. civil_filing_fee is null when not yet verified (fee_status "unknown"), and some counties have no fixed fee (fee_status "clerk_sets_deposit"). Tell the user to confirm fees with the clerk before filing, and cite the 1Court page URL.

state.description: State name, 2-letter code, or slug, e.g. "Texas", "TX"

name: get_court_info
